subject.name: Refuse and recyclable material collectors
subject.summary: Collects refuse or recyclables from containers along an established route, loads them into a collection vehicle, and delivers them to a designated location; some positions drive the vehicle. The work includes pre-trip vehicle checks, operating loading or lifting equipment, communicating anomalies with dispatch, and handoff records. Vehicle movement, reversing, compactor mechanisms, physical lifting, and weather risks must be controlled per on-site procedures.
